sources.snippet: The NVIDIA H100 SXM is the Hopper-generation datacenter accelerator that powered the first wave of large-scale LLM deployment. Each chip pairs 80 GB of HBM3 at 3.35 TB/s with fourth-generation tensor cores that reach 1,979 dense FP8 TFLOP/s, connected in 8-chip nodes over NVLink 4.0 at 450 GB/s per chip.
